storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
SERP CamSoda Downloader makes it easy to record live streams and download videos from CamSoda.com.

How it works: Open any model page on CamSoda while they're live, then click the download button on the player or the extension icon. The extension detects the stream via CamSoda's API, shows available quality options, and captures it as a standard MP4 file. For live streams, click Start to begin recording and Stop when you're done. For recorded videos (VOD), it downloads the full file automatically.

It handles LL-HLS streaming, Mouflon DRM decryption, edge server selection, and token management automatically — no external tools, no command line, no technical knowledge required.

Key features:
- Live stream capture — records from CamSoda in real time
- VOD download — save recorded model videos
- In-page download button right on the video player
- Converts HLS streams to standard MP4 files in your browser
- Quality selection from all available resolutions
- Real-time capture progress with elapsed time
- Right-click context menu for quick capture
- Mouflon DRM handling — works where other tools fail
- Dark-themed UI with coral pink accents
- 3 free downloads to try before you buy

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Go to CamSoda.com and open a model page
3. Click the download button on the player or the extension icon
4. Select quality, click Start — saved as MP4 when you stop

Sign in with your email to unlock 3 free trial downloads. Upgrade to a license for unlimited capture.

Supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, and more.

faq.question: How do I record a live stream?
faq.answer: Open a model page on CamSoda.com while they're live. Click the download button or extension icon, select your quality, and click Start. The capture runs until you click Stop or the stream ends. The recording saves as MP4.

faq.question: Can I download recorded videos too?
faq.answer: Yes. Navigate to a model's video page (VOD) and the extension will detect and download the recording. Some videos may require purchase or fan-club access on CamSoda.

faq.question: What quality options are available?
faq.answer: The extension parses the HLS master manifest and shows all available quality variants — typically multiple resolutions sorted by quality (highest first).

faq.question: What format are downloaded videos?
faq.answer: All captures and downloads are saved as standard MP4 files that play on any device or media player.

faq.question: Where are my downloads saved?
faq.answer: Videos save to your browser's default Downloads directory.

faq.question: How many free downloads do I get?
faq.answer: 3 free trial downloads after signing in with your email. Purchase a license for unlimited capture.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Yes — supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox.

faq.question: Why isn't the extension detecting the stream?
faq.answer: Make sure the model is live and the stream is playing. The extension needs the stream to be active before it can detect it. If the model is offline or in a private show, you'll see a status message.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. Stream capture and processing happen entirely in your browser. Authentication uses secure OTP — no passwords stored.
